work.description: The act names the archbishop of Goa apostolic delegate for six years. Issuer evidence: PIVS EPISCOPVS SERVVS SERVORVM DEI at LF9424-9427. Dating LF9605-9607 reads: Datum Romae apud S. Petrum sub Annulo Pi- scatoris die XXII martii MDCCCLXI. , pontificatus Nostri anno XV.
